title: Samach Vav Part 250: Fusing yechuda i'laah and yechuda ta'taah -- utter bittul while engaging
blurb: Samach Vav p. 202: Fusing yechuda i'laah and yechuda ta'taah -- utter bittul while engaging -- higher than yechuda i'laah alone, which negates and nullifies all of existence. and from the G-dly perspective, there is no concealment, and Elokus radiates in existence just like before existence. By contrast, the yichud of yechuda i'laah and yechuda ta'taah is that even existence itself recognizes the utter bittul of non-existence. Even when engaged in a meal, like in the meals of Shabbos, he doesn't feel the pleasure of the material food. The same is with the meals of tzaddikim in the weekdays. This level of yichus is far higher than yechuda i'laah, which does not engage with the world, and certainly higher than the bittul of klos ha'nefesh.
